name: services/users/pesel
description: Get information on a user given by PESEL number.
brief_description: Get information on a user given by PESEL number.

arguments.name: pesel
arguments.description: Pesel number. Must be an exact match.

arguments.name: fields
arguments.description: Selector of result fields you are interested in. The selector may contain any subset of fields, which are described in the returns section of user method.

arguments.name: format
arguments.description: Format in which to return values. See supported output formats.

arguments.name: callback
arguments.description: Required only if you've chosen jsonp as a return format.

returns: A dictionary that contains a user description, as defined in the user method.
errors: • object_not_found - some of the referenced objects do not exist; param_name is equal to pesel.
